notes.title: Stronghold Crusader: DE - First Major Update Details!
notes.content:
[h3][i]Well met, Sire![/i] Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition has charged into the breach and emerged from its launch victorious! The response of fans and critics to Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition has been nothing short of stellar. [/h3][p][/p][p]While we're still working hard to add the updates, fixes and tweaks that players have been requesting (see our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3024040/discussions/0/596281849306801145/"]extensive v1.03 Patch Notes[/url] for the latest changes), Firefly Studios is keeping this momentum going by revealing some of the details of new gameplay content that players can look forward to[/p][p][/p][p]The first major ‘Autumn’ update will arrive in two parts -  a free content update as well as an optional paid DLC. The free content will introduce The Crocodile, a brand new computer-controlled opponent with his own tactics, castle design, army and of course, snappy personality![/p][p][/p][h3] > [b][u][url="https://youtu.be/Yn98HHTPl4k"]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition Tacticon Showcase[/url][/u][/b] <[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/b86d8ee7078fe5c7b55d77d3634979d2160566c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The wizened lord of the marshes, The Crocodile is a bitter cruel fellow, driven beyond sanity by envy of his rival lords. Players will encounter The Crocodile across a new five mission economic campaign, in addition to being playable in skirmish mode (and in case you’re wondering - yes, the game has [i]actual [/i]crocodiles, too.) [/p][p][/p][p]While there will be some degree of combat to contend with in the economic campaigns, the ultimate goal and thus victory will be decided by mastery of the game’s various economic industries and castle-life mechanics. The free component of the Autumn Update will be capped off by the inclusion of three new maps, one for Skirmish, Freebuild and Multiplayer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/7e913c19b867710e01e146ce956448016cbc3536.png"][/img][/p][p]The paid DLC will feature two new CPU commanders in the form of The Canary and The Trader, and a new 9 mission ‘Sands of Time’ skirmish trail - complete with target completion times and leaderboards. Players can expect military scenarios will test their strategic prowess and skills of siegecraft, as they wage war against these new tricky CPU characters. Fear not, more about these new adversaries and their attributes will be revealed in due time![/p][hr][/hr][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/59e21472a7555da6a8e316f878fe973f43fe3f13.png"][/img][/p][p]After Stronghold Crusader: DE’s fantastic launch, Firefly is highly determined to keep pushing further, through the likes of additional content updates and gameplay improvements, to truly make this definitive edition the completely elevated tribute of a strategy classic![/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Play Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition on Steam now![/i][/b][/h2][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Better-looking, smoother-running and bigger in all ways possible, Stronghold Crusader: DE is the ultimate way to take a trip down memory lane.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/d00e71b9e422ace830648eb4cf99b46888c12bb8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Critical Reception[/h3][p][b]Inverse (9/10)[/b] -- [i]"This Definitive Edition is a genuinely massive update that improves the game in a handful of crucial ways. Got feedback? [/b]Please submit issues both large and small through the [url="https://firefly-studios.helpshift.com/hc/en/15-stronghold-definitive-edition/contact-us/"]Firefly Studios support site[/url]. Between this and our [b]planned post-launch roadmap[/b] we are dedicated to fixing any significant issues players are having and the more reports we get the faster and more effectively we can do that :)[/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https:///url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZanPPwupPz4"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition Roadmap Reveal
notes.content:
[h3]Good Day Sire! Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition is just under two weeks away from its launch, so what better time than now to share all there is to know about its post-launch plans![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="71UzpnLOH7U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Following the positive reception of the two public demos and in keeping with Stronghold DE’s post-launch, we're announcing two major post-launch content updates for Stronghold Crusader DE. These will take the form of an Autumn and a Winter Update, both releasing this year alongside two paid DLCs.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45452156/8f40990ce7a71421b643639197584c99a4027f26.png"][/img][/p][p]The free initial Autumn Update will feature a series-first economic campaign as well as a brand new CPU commander. Five missions will challenge players to complete a series of economic objectives, leaning heavily into the city builder gameplay mechanics of the legendary castle builder series. The new computer-controlled character can meanwhile also be played as friend or foe, selectable in the game’s offline skirmish and online multiplayer modes. Last but not least, three new maps will also be added, one for skirmish, another in Free Build mode and a balanced multiplayer battlefield.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45452156/5313cab036a111f6c5b495987e9b8564aad4fdd7.png"][/img][/p][p]Following this content drop, the game’s free Winter Update will add perhaps the greatest player request so far: the ability to customise CPU opponents, castles and campaigns! Players will be able to create the rivals or allies of their dreams (or nightmares), design their defences and then place all of this into custom mission scenarios created by the community.[/p][p] [/p][p]If that wasn’t enough, the Winter Update continues this community-first trend with the addition of a second co-op trail of missions. The 10 missions found in the first co-op trail not enough for you? Well, dare to brave the challenges of this new trail and you [i]just [/i]might come out victorious. Once again a new map pack of three maps will be added to the overall pool, keeping things fresh for players after launch.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition launches soon on July 15th. Wishlist now to be the first to know when it goes live![/h2]

notes.title: New Coop Trailer & Next Fest
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="pXejCnia8tc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Good tidings, Sire! Steam Next Fest is now live and with it our second public demo for [b]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition[/b]. Showcasing the latest fixes, a full Sands of Time mission, Historical Campaign challenge and allowing you to freely try out Custom Skirmish mode before the game’s July 15th launch, this is our most content rich demo yet! So if you haven’t yet given it a try or think you can rise even higher on the leaderboards, now is the chance to prove your mettle…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/f31175fe2a59eb5b38fcfa0887614d2337a31aee.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Crusader: DE was designed with your feedback in mind and at the very top of that list were features like a proper coop mode. In past games we have offered coop in the form of team-based skirmish play and - In the case of Stronghold Crusader 2 - The ability for two players to control the same castle. In Crusader: DE we have gone a step further and designed a full 10 mission skirmish trail, allowing two players to cooperate and defeat the AI across a selection of new maps… With one or two classic battlefields thrown in there for good measure![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/5122089a08847a6e822d67e5ef76f327250b69d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Featuring the game’s new AI opponents, units and more, this mode takes full advantage of everything Crusader: DE has to offer. In addition to all of this, we are pleased to announce that - Even though it's called a ‘Coop Trail’ - Solo players won’t be left out in the cold. If for whatever reason you are unable to buddy up with another human player online, the trail is fully playable with the help of one of our 20 AI characters! Battle alongside everyone from The Snake to The Sentinel, as you conquer this fresh take on classic skirmish trail gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/09b0b6d9de45258482f62b6afdf7adeafc40898b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Nothing forges stronger bonds than conquering challenges together. Whether it’s reuniting with distant pals, bonding with a new crusading comrade or finally teaming up with the Lord of Rats himself, the series-first coop mode for Stronghold Crusader: DE will be your chance to create new memories across fresh battlefields![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Stronghold Crusader DE Feature Spotlight: 10k Unit Cap, Mosques & More!
notes.content:
[h3]Good morrow, my liege! [/h3]After 150,000 demo downloads, three times as many as Stronghold: Definitive Edition... We have channelled thousands of your Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition feedback forms into new player-requested enhancements!

[url=https://youtu.be/js6TBaUA8QQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/c24564dfa03288026148dc565aab9897c05aa756.jpg[/img][/url]

Ahead of the game's July 15th launch, today we dive into some of these community-requested features, confirming key information on maximum unit counts and more in our final ‘Feature Spotlight’ development diary.

As some of Crusader’s most knowledgeable and experienced players, your feedback on our upcoming Definitive Edition has been invaluable. So naturally suggestions and ideas discussed online were studied in close detail, ahead of the game’s reveal earlier this year. Your Crusader: DE feedback was then examined after January 20th through the demo’s feedback form.
Many features have been requested by players since January.

[url=https://youtu.be/js6TBaUA8QQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/b1aef7bb484c7d3703313c64d0336dbd82d79a71.png[/img][/url]

These include raising the overall troop count to a whopping 10,000 soldiers in a single game, to match that of Stronghold Crusader Extreme, which we can confirm today. We have also made the addition of a few Islamic buildings and related workers for the game’s Arabic and Bedouin Lords, as well as many vital bug fixes. The latter addresses specific exploits and issues discovered by the game’s most dedicated players across more than 20 years of play.

[url=https://youtu.be/js6TBaUA8QQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/c0df1d7dcfef1b0424b0019399ec1b9064ff6e27.png[/img][/url]

From map sizes up to four times the size of those available in the original, through to custom toggles for skirmish mode and online leader boards, we are striving to tick every possible box for fans of the original game. A Definitive Edition should include absolutely everything possible that players want out of Crusader and that’s what this final version of our game intends to deliver!

[h3]Wishlist Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition today![/h3]

notes.title: Feature Spotlight: New Units In Stronghold Crusader DE!
notes.content:
[h3]Good day, my liege![/h3] After a few eagle-eyed players infiltrated the help files, Assassin style, in our Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition reveal demo, we thought it was time to pull back the curtain on our 8 new units. Today’s Feature Spotlight video brings with it new footage and juicy gameplay details for our Bedouin soldiers, expanding the original roster with fresh tactical options at launch on July 15th.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=um9P-_v5RSM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/9be649ca707adcdbf2c0df2939e3965f697f8918.jpg[/img][/url]

Inspired by the roaming Bedouin tribes of the Middle Eastern deserts, these eight new troops open up a whole new world of siege tactics (and hurt!) on your rival lords. Be they friends you played the OG Crusader with way back in the day or new Stronghold allies found in our official Discord server[discord.com], enemy Lords and Ladies won’t know what hit them. From camel-riding lancers and bowmen, to sneaking fire-starters and demolition specialists, our expanded remaster adds plenty of new options for commanders in the art of medieval warfare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/58d76785a7cfcd7f45c4121597a35f407bb2cbcd.png[/img]

In our latest Feature Spotlight we reveal exactly what these new units are capable of and how you might use them to your advantage in your next medieval conquest. So please check out the video, learn their strengths, weaknesses and let us know what you think in the comments below! Player feedback has been a huge part of the success of our Definitive Editions, so as always we’d love to hear your thoughts for this upcoming game and of course future titles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/36187f08ed05c18b04032033b2e839e421139ae2.png[/img]

[h3]Stay tuned for future videos to hear more about the updates and improvements coming to Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition and wishlist the game to be notified of the game's release at launch.[/h3]

notes.content:

[b]Snarls[/b] Soon you will see what it means to wage real warfare! That is... In our final instalment of the [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] 'Jewel' campaign! Under the tutelage of the wise Sergeant, finish the fight by rescuing Sir Longarm's captured kin once and for all, when this new DLC releases for $2.99, €2.99 and £2.49 on April 30th.

This final chapter of 'The Jewel' campaign pits players against the greatest rogue of them all... The vicious Wolf! Malbork, the fortress erected by the Teutonic Order to signify their Prussian conquest, Biskupin, an ancient stronghold built at the dawn of Rome, and Niedzica, a daunting gothic castle that Dracula would be proud of, will all be found in the new castle trail, while another castle, Ogrodzieniec, will be playable as a standalone map through Siege mode. All will be made available for free as part of the Spring Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/4c4b82cdb725233e21086e10e8780ad4a5da0f9e.jpg[/img]

So please keep an eye on our socials for the latest news!

Be sure to return on April 30th and check out our full patch notes at release, for both the paid Valley of the Wolf DLC and free Spring Update. These will include a run down of other minor features, fixes and improvements coming to the game as part of the Spring Update in version 1.3.

notes.title: The Future of Stronghold
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sweRL93xNcA;full][/previewyoutube]
Happy New Year! After a launch that quite frankly exceeded all our expectations... We are pleased to announce that the first substantial gameplay update for [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] releases on Steam on February 13th! A simultaneous launch of free content and paid DLC, the Winter Update will be available to all players, while the [i]Swine's Bay Campaign[/i] DLC will retail for $2.99, £2.49 or €2.99.

Feeling lucky? You could even win this DLC through a giveaway being run in the above development diary! Check it out to learn more and get the inside track on what to expect of Firefly in 2024 and beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/4d8dda87abf2aeff2e162483401ef6a1aa1101e2.jpg[/img]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yea-aUi9z4k]As announced before launch[/url], we intend to support [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] with both free and paid post-launch content, releasing as two major updates. The aim of each DLC is to offer fresh missions, created by veteran developers for players who want to challenge their two decades of castle sim experience. While the free updates will bring a host of fixes and improvements, alongside extra missions designed to compliment the main story.

Releasing on February 13th, the [i]Swine's Bay Campaign[/i] DLC follows the events of the main game and is narrated by returning series actor Christopher Kent. Players will be met with seven ruthless military combat scenarios across original maps, as they seek to retrieve the Jewel of the North from the clutches of the infamous slaver Captain Hogsfoot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/f992b7e75fc60c200103baeeca6b478c3228afe6.jpg[/img]
Releasing alongside this DLC, our free Winter Update will add a second economic campaign, voiced by another returning Stronghold actor in Jay Simon! These missions are designed to test players’ strategic skills beyond the warfront, with a series of resource production and management challenges. Kingdoms may be crushed by warriors, but they can only be raised by those with the vision to build.

Looking forward to the future we are actively engaged in a number of projects, the most prominent of which is the as of yet untitled ‘Stronghold Unreal’ project, built using Unreal Engine 5. Needless to say, witnessing the love for mechanically deep, passionately made strategy games like [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] has lit a fire under our little studio and the team can’t wait to share more!

In the meantime our [i]Swine's Bay Campaign[/i] is available to Wishlist, ahead of its release on February 13th:

notes.title: Stronghold: Definitive Edition - Out Now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ruV_3DowJWs;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings sire! Your stronghold awaits you. The ultimate version of our first ‘castle sim’ is now available on Steam with upgraded visuals, new missions, Steam multiplayer support and more. We are incredibly excited to be launching our first 2D Stronghold game with new content for over 20 years and even more thrilled by your warm response to the game over the past few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/8e7571a04a7dae7c85d0f778d50230d9f0a975d8.jpg[/img]

When we were in the planning stages for [i]Stronghold: Definitive Editio[/i]n we had faith in the demand for new 2D isometric strategy games, but could never be 100% sure. Your overwhelming support, feedback and love for our series’ 2D roots made this project possible and we cannot wait to hear what you think of it. This game has been a labour of love for the team, both for Stronghold 1 itself and also a bygone golden era of isometric 2D strategy. We hope that shines through, as we continue to improve it with updates and new content into early 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/36fc1016a6dec4e5816267be59251658594dda89.jpg[/img]

As a way of saying ‘Thank you!’ on the community side, please enjoy our launch trailer scored by series maestro Robert L. Euvino with a brand new Castle Jam inspired composition. The man himself was kind enough to compose this new piece for today's trailer, a roaring tribute to your favourite Stronghold song, celebrating the launch of a project that is dear to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/231b97f5afc27a9b757e0b754c5a04c705a85f4b.jpg[/img]

[i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] comes packed with updated graphics made using the original source art, a new 14 mission single player campaign, 10 mission historical castle trail, remastered audio, returning voice actors, community requested features, gameplay modernisations, Steam multiplayer, Workshop support and more.

It is out now on Steam with a 10% launch week discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140020/Stronghold_Definitive_Edition/

[b]Seen a bug? Got feedback? notes.title: Post-Release Roadmap
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Yea-aUi9z4k;full][/previewyoutube]
Our final pre-release update for [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] is a big one... As we reveal our post-release plans for the game!

We can now commit to two major updates for the game, with a new economic campaign and second castle trail planned alongside new maps and the usual mix of smaller features and fixes. These two updates will release early next year and arrive at the same time as one of two paid DLC military campaigns, which will each cost $2.99, £2.49 or €2.99.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/a77c65a6993ca409bf81ee3f0f5a1c792e8473b0.jpg[/img]
It gives us great pleasure to confirm these today alongside a recap of community driven features added since our most recent public demo, which now include (optional) auto-trading and selectable team colours in all game modes! During our two public demos and player surveys thousands of you told us that post-launch support and paid DLC were both of interest, so we made plans to release these in early 2024.

Featuring a new story designed by series creator Simon Bradbury, our second economic campaign will involve the work of rebuilding a kingdom nearly shattered by the warring exploits of The Rat, Snake, Pig and Wolf. Narrated by OG Stronghold voice actor Jay Simon, you will travel north to restore peace and order to homelands ravaged by the conflict of the military campaigns over the course of seven unique missions as part of our larger [b]Winter Update[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/c389b0c1f1d953fcb6d947907011bb753d3247cc.png[/img]
Following on from this our [b]Spring Update[/b] will include a second Castle Trail, which will feature a ‘greatest hits’ mix of old and new historical castles to besiege and defend. As with the base game trail we’re looking at including at least 10 historical castles, with Polish strongholds making their long overdue debut.

Each of our two paid DLCs will release with these updates and come in the form of two new military campaigns, each offering 7 military missions. ‘Swine’s Bay’ and ‘Valley of the Wolf’ will feature the return of two popular series antagonists and lead directly on from the 14 missions included in the [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] base game. You can expect the difficulty to scale up, some formidable new win conditions and a true challenge for series veterans!

notes.title: New Dev Diaries & Gameplay
notes.content:

[previewyoutube=ZVyWb3tqtds;full][/previewyoutube]

In our second [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] dev diary we discuss the genesis of the game, while delving into changes made as part of this new edition. Join Stronghold series veterans Simon and Paul, as they provide insight into the creation of our latest game from their unique perspectives.

We discuss the aims of Stronghold: DE and goals for everything from new single player content, all the way down to the smallest quality of life enhancements. Starting with the initial project pitch, then leading to questions of the scale of changes and finer elements like the actual difficulty of the new content, the road to release has been carefully considered.

It also gives us great pleasure in this video to confirm some of these changes and a few entirely new ones! In response to player feedback we have increased troop and building limits across all game modes, allowing for up to 3000 units and 2000 buildings at a time. By doubling these limits from the original game, we hope to provide you with more epic Stronghold sieges than ever before.

[previewyoutube=Y6dqDSJov1w;full][/previewyoutube]

Making Stronghold more accessible has always been a key goal of the Definitive Edition and bringing our amazing multiplayer community - as well as the awesome maps they've created over the course of two decades - front and centre within Steam is how we're hoping to accomplish that. Thousands of fan creations can soon exist within Steam Workshop and be easily accessible for future generations of Stronghold players, with an improved set of multiplayer options to support years of continued play.
